decisions.reason: As a small component innovation that disappeared from marketing after launch, it likely revealed limited standalone upside quickly, so keeping the option open no longer justifies attention and sales complexity.

The electric infrared panel heater lost its dedicated web presence within a year, suggesting weak market traction or weak fit with the firm's core large-project solution business, so the option should be abandoned.
The electric halogen infrared heater was also removed from visible promotion after launch, indicating that uncertainty has largely resolved unfavorably and resources are better redeployed elsewhere.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater gained stronger promotion and reference use after launch, fits the firm's strategic move toward lower-carbon heating, and still offers significant upside under continuing market uncertainty.
